title: Dragonfly Woman in Lotus Pond
description: A green-skinned woman with a white headwrap and golden dragonfly wings stands waist-deep in a pond filled with lily pads and blooming pink lotuses. Behind her is a repeating zigzag pattern of orange, green, and white stripes with four mirrored images of a woman in an orange floral dress holding a handbag, set against a cloudy sky with floating blue bubbles.
prompt: A green-skinned woman with white headwrap emerging from a pond filled with lily pads and pink lotus flowers, large golden dragonfly wings on her back, standing waist deep in water. Behind her is a bold repeating zigzag pattern in orange green and white with four identical images of a woman in an orange floral dress holding a handbag, cloudy sky above, blue bubbles floating, surreal symbolic style with vibrant colors and detailed textures.
